title: The Importance of Preventive Dentistry: Why Early Care Saves You Money
seoTitle: Preventive Dentistry: Why Early Dental Care Saves Money
seoDescription: What preventive dentistry includes, how often to see a dentist, and why catching cavities and gum disease early saves money, pain and teeth.
excerpt: Dental problems get more expensive at every stage. Here is what preventive dentistry includes, how often to visit a dentist, what the evidence says about gum health and the rest of the body, and simple daily habits that protect your teeth.
